text: Monitor before spending on validation.
Concept measured: Meditation (Wikidata Q108458). A broader or narrower concept can give a different result.
Meditation · en.wikipedia: 311,869 views a year; -20.8% year over year, against -7.0% for the whole edition: 14.9% worse than the edition as a whole.
Timing: attention to Meditation · en.wikipedia peaks in January (1.19× the average month), so plan launches and campaigns ahead of it.

For Meditation · en.wikipedia, momentum is accelerating: the last 3 months changed +58.4% on the 3 before, after a weaker 3 months before that. The latest flagged month (2026-08, +45.6% against its baseline) is provisional, so confirm the rise before relying on it.

Basis: Wikipedia reader attention only, not revenue or product demand. This is not a go/no-go or investment call: before committing budget, confirm with search volume, app-store demand and customer interviews.

observations: Annual pageviews (2025-09..2026-08) were 311.9K (about 26.0K a month).
Pageviews decreased 20.8% year over year (2025-09..2026-08 vs 2024-09..2025-08).
Three-year CAGR was -17.9% (vs 2022-09..2023-08).
The last 3 months were +58.4% against the previous 3 months; momentum accelerating.

3 potential anomalies flagged; the largest was +122.2% against its baseline in 2026-06 (cause unknown). With the flagged months replaced by their expected values, the year-over-year change would be -31.7%.

formulas.name: previous_three_month_growth

formulas.name: acceleration

formulas.name: peak_to_average

formulas.name: trough_to_average

formulas.name: topic_share

formulas.edge_cases: relative to the compared set; editions without data are excluded and listed

formulas.name: topic_affinity

formulas.edge_cases: location quotient relative to the compared editions; not an official Wikimedia metric

formulas.name: anomaly_expected

formulas.edge_cases: deduplicated with typed relations first; capped at 20; concepts without an article in the edition are skipped and counted

formulas.name: share_adjusted_yoy
